posts.name: khubaib Naveed
posts.cooked:
Hi everyone,

I’m Khubaib, an n8n builder and I’m taking on new freelance projects. If your team or your clients need automations that work in real life and don’t just look good in a demo, I can help.

Where I can help

  • AI voice agents that answer calls, qualify callers and book appointments straight into Google Calendar (built with Retell AI and n8n)
  • Lead capture and follow up systems that pick up leads from Facebook, email and web forms, reply within seconds, qualify them and book the meeting
  • Multi channel ecommerce sync for listings and stock across Shopify, Amazon and eBay, with a shared Supabase table so nothing drifts out of sync
  • AI agents connected to Gmail, Google Sheets, Calendar, Docs and CRMs, including a Streamlit front end when a client needs one
  • Document workflows where AI reads a contract or form, extracts the key data, and sends anything uncertain to a human for a quick check

How I work
I add human approval steps wherever a wrong action would cost the client money, and I build in checks for things like double bookings and missing information. I document what I deliver and hand over the exported workflow JSON. I’m happy to start with a small paid test project so you can see how I work before committing.
Proof

Code and projects: khubaib12345678 · GitHub
Availability
I’m in UTC+ and can give 20 to 30 hours a week. Send me a DM here with what you want to automate and I’ll tell you honestly if I can help and what it would take.

Thanks
Khubaib
